response.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS disp_rows FROM disp WHERE account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM disp WHERE type = 'DISPONENT');

assumptions.assumption: A disponent account is an account with at least one disp row whose type is 'DISPONENT', and the disp rows for all other accounts (those with only OWNER and/or USER rows) are counted. disp.type values are matched exactly in uppercase, as documented.

alternatives.interpretation: Count only the disp rows whose own type is not 'DISPONENT', without looking at the other rows of the same account.
alternatives.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS disp_rows FROM disp WHERE type <> 'DISPONENT';
